verdict.rationale: Convex documents an optional code-defined schema that its CLI watches on the local filesystem and pushes to the dev deployment, so schema changes live in source files and are applied through the CLI. Nothing in the pack shows a migrations framework, ordered migration files, data backfills, or production/CI deploy of schema changes. missing for 10: versioned migration files or tooling, data-migration support, CI/production deployment of schema changes, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage schema changes as version-controlled migrations applied via the CLI or CI

citations.quote: Watches the local filesystem. When you change a function or the schema, the new versions are pushed to your dev deployment and the generated types in convex/_generated are updated.
Though optional, schemas ensure that your data looks exactly how you want.
